t: This is 8 to 10 Stratford Place, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Richard Edwin, a British architect who was active in Marylebone and died in 1778. He also designed the neighbouring numbers, 2 to 7 and 12 and 13, so you're seeing part of a larger group of his work on this street. I don't have more detail than that, so take a moment to look at the frontage and compare it with the houses either side.
